current_scene.prompt: Bobby has just pointed to the free-agent board. Bryan chooses his response.

timeline.title: Ascend origins
timeline.detail: Bryan founds five-employee Washington ICT firm.

timeline.title: Powerball jackpot
timeline.detail: Jonathan gifts winning ticket; $1B advertised jackpot.

timeline.title: Family foundations
timeline.detail: Q first date Jan 2, marriage Mar 27, pets join, estate purchase and Lindy interview.

timeline.title: Ascend expands
timeline.detail: Two acquisitions totaling $40M; $10M shortened-year gross revenue; $286.8M illustrative investment allocation.

timeline.title: Bitcoin investments
timeline.detail: Initial $20M purchased; March $10M sale directed but execution not confirmed.

timeline.title: Oklahoma relocation
timeline.detail: Estate completed and occupied; Lindy total annual salary raised to $200K.

timeline.title: Ascend global expansion
timeline.detail: International growth and nine acquisitions established; no invented individual deal details.

timeline.title: Cardinals negotiations end
timeline.detail: Bidwill relocation restriction unacceptable; Indianapolis becomes acquisition target.

timeline.title: Irsay commercial framework
timeline.detail: Valuation $6.8B, 70/30, 2027 OKC target, employee protections, charitable program.

timeline.title: Colts acquisition CLOSED
timeline.detail: Bryan 51%, syndicate 19%, Irsay 30%; $4.76B settled, Ascend 36.4% sold.

timeline.title: Leadership and relocation planning
timeline.detail: Sarah accepts $350K business operations role; Bobby accepts football operations role (paperwork pending). Goodell advances fee proposal for review; Nov 5 confidential briefing is not a vote. Five logistics candidates evaluated confidentially.

timeline.title: Household celebration
timeline.detail: Family celebrates acquisition with dinner and cake.

timeline.title: First facility visit and press conference
timeline.detail: Bryan tours with Bobby, Sarah and Emily; retains coaching staff through 2026. Press conference 2:29–3:23 PM EST, 43 journalists; Daniel Mercer and Mina Kimes participate. No relocation announced.

timeline.title: Fictional ESPN article published
timeline.detail: National coverage of 28-year-old owner, Ascend, Bobby, coaching commitment, Indianapolis uncertainty and Hudl clips. Views rise from 99 to 79,121.

timeline.title: Current household checkpoint
timeline.detail: Q and Lindy watch highlights. Q asks about telling their daughter; Bryan has not replied. Q pregnant with Braylee, due March 20, 2027.

timeline.title: Confidential owners briefing
timeline.detail: Bisons branding presented; no approval or vote. Nov 11 target, $375M fee over five years proposed.

timeline.title: Mercer and Mina interviews completed
timeline.detail: Mercer 10:02–11:12 AM EST; Mina 1:00–1:51 PM. Recorded five-year championship promise; private documentary pitch 1:52–2:08 PM, no approval.

timeline.title: Dallas defeat
timeline.detail: Colts lost to Cowboys 27–23; date, stats and season record unprovided.

timeline.title: Pete and Scot join leadership
timeline.detail: Pete senior advisor; Scot personnel executive. Exact contract details unprovided.

timeline.title: Trade deadline roster overhaul
timeline.detail: 11 completed packages, separate Chargers pick adjustment, 13 signings, Grupe released. Herbert/Hampton centerpiece; latest inventory 22 picks over 2027–28.

timeline.title: Five seconds too late
timeline.detail: Williams verbal agreement invalid; Seattle keeps player, Colts keep #69. Golden offer declined; #104 retained.

timeline.title: Current checkpoint
timeline.detail: Leadership laughing after deadline; next scene unchosen.

timeline.title: Relocation approved
timeline.detail: 30–1–1 for 2027. $375M over five years.

timeline.title: Internal rollout
timeline.detail: Carlie and Bryan brief employees, players first learn at 6:07 PM. Andy receives expanded duties and raise.

timeline.title: Public press conference concluded
timeline.detail: Emily waits with the Thursday schedule. Early exchanges missing from supplied archive.

timeline.title: Miami win
timeline.detail: 30–19 in Herbert debut.

timeline.title: Bisons identity revealed
timeline.detail: Name, logo and colors public. Stadium funding passed 92–8.

timeline.title: Giants win
timeline.detail: 17–13 after 51–14 Houston win. Colts 5–7.

timeline.title: Ascend exit
timeline.detail: Remaining stake sold. Investment allocations approved, deployment pending.

timeline.title: Irsay buyout and promotions
timeline.detail: Bryan 81%. Bobby and Sarah presidents. Andy verbally accepts director role.

timeline.title: Cleveland win
timeline.detail: 35–16. Colts 8–8 and eliminated. Hampton shoulder injury.

timeline.title: Farewell and Syntergy planning
timeline.detail: Mina call, employee transition review and proposed Seattle venture.

timeline.title: Employee farewell
timeline.detail: 284 employees recognized. Bryan extends the 7% annual base salary bonus to all employees.

timeline.title: Indianapolis wins its final game
timeline.detail: 20–14 over Jacksonville, 9–8 final record. Player speeches, final fan photograph, employee field access and Irsay farewell completed.

timeline.title: Relocation preparations finalized
timeline.detail: Lake Hefner HQ and practice facilities approved for opening. Physical move scheduled for February 10.

timeline.title: The Colts’ Farewell Season premieres
timeline.detail: Mina Kimes and Rachel Park present the completed 98-minute film at a private Oklahoma City screening.

timeline.title: Oklahoma City relocation completed
timeline.detail: Lake Hefner HQ and practice facilities operational.

timeline.title: Farewell documentary extended cut
timeline.detail: 98-minute private premiere February 1. Final 124-minute cut screened privately February 22. Network distribution approved, public date pending.

timeline.title: Bisons acquire Bijan Robinson
timeline.detail: Atlanta receives Hampton, Aiyuk, 2027 No. 22 and 2028 fourth No. 112. Hampton passed his physical. Oklahoma City retains No. 13.
